title: wWaypoints
body:
![0.7.0 On patreon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/babf9b57bc0e7aab3c048a0abe81e3cda8a9ed6f.jpeg)

### Officially Allowed on Hoplite

wWaypoints is the new best waypoint mod. It has unique features including, multi-block waypoints, customizable icons, clean folders, tons of customization and much more.

The mod has additional features such as toggle sneak improvement and a toggleable sign GUI popup designed to make trapping much better.
### Why is it the best waypoint mod?
- Easy to use with clean, optimized menus
- Most customization out of any similar mod
- Highlights blocks, making it the #1 Trapping mod
